children: Market concerns that tighter Chinese outbound investment rules could weaken growth in CTF Services' insurance business are likely overdone, says Citi analyst Timothy Chau in a note. The conglomerate's FY26 operating profit of 4.5 billion Hong Kong dollars beat Citi's estimate by roughly 2%, and CTF can sustain its dividend without insurance contributions, Chau says. Citi raises its target price to from HK$10.30 to HK$10.40 following minor FY27-28 forecast adjustments and keeps a buy rating. Shares are up 6.6% at HK$8.405. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
